article.title: What I’ve been reading
article.excerpt: Frederick C. Beiser, The German Historicist Tradition . Lengthy and dense, but full of good material and written with extreme indeed almost unbelievable clarity. The historicists are these days the underdiscussed approach in the history of German thought. Have you ever wondered why Justus Möser was important, and why he focused on the history of Osnabrück
